findings.description: The cycle guard was removed from the __cause__ walk, so a cyclic exception chain now loops forever instead of terminating.
findings.rationale: Trigger: the retried function raises an exception whose __cause__ chain cycles, for example a.__cause__ = b and b.__cause__ = a, and no exception in the cycle matches exception_cause_types. Mechanism: the while loop at line 180 only exits when exc becomes None, and with a cycle it never does, so the retry predicate never returns. Impact: the caller hangs indefinitely inside the retry check instead of getting a result.
